milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The birch wall sign is at spawn-relative (3, 2, 4) on the north face of an oak log post ~6 blocks south of spawn. Player must turn around and walk south to find it. Max distance 4 ensures intentional navigation since spawn is ~6 blocks away. Facing tolerance 60 confirms player is looking at the sign to read directional hints.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The pig is summoned at spawn-relative (10, 1, -1) inside a fenced pen in the barn to the east. Pig is contained by oak fences at z=0 and barn wall at z=-3, giving it a 2-block deep pen. Max distance 6 accounts for slight pig movement within the pen while requiring the player to navigate to the barn area (~10 blocks east of spawn).

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The jungle door is at spawn-relative (9, 0, 0) on the west wall of the barn. Player must approach the barn entrance and face the door to identify it as a jungle door. Max distance 4 requires close approach.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The lodestone is at spawn-relative (0, 0, -9) inside the stone brick crafting hub to the north. Player must follow the cobblestone path north and enter the building through the entrance at (0, 0, -7). Max distance 4 requires entering the building interior.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The potted brown mushroom is at spawn-relative (-4, 1, -9) in the storage room adjacent to the crafting hub. Player must pass through the connecting doorway at (-2, 0, -9) to enter the storage room. Max distance 4 requires entering the small room.

Uses inventory_has because the crafted furnace ends up in the player's inventory. Player retrieves 8 cobblestone from the chest at (-4, 0, -8) and crafts at the crafting table at (1, 0, -9). Recipe: 8 cobblestone in a ring pattern. Furnace is not in starting inventory so its presence confirms successful crafting.

Uses inventory_has because the crafted magenta carpet ends up in the player's inventory. Two-step recipe: (1) white_wool + magenta_dye → magenta_wool, (2) 2 magenta_wool in a row → 3 magenta_carpet. Materials from chest. No pre-placed magenta_carpet exists in scene (dig spot uses lime_carpet instead), so inventory presence can only be achieved through crafting.

Uses inventory_has because the crafted white bed ends up in the player's inventory. Recipe: 3 white wool (top row) + 3 oak planks (bottom row) at crafting table. Materials from chest at (-4, 0, -8). White bed is not in starting inventory so its presence confirms successful crafting.

Uses inventory_has because mining a spruce fence gate drops the item into the player's inventory. The gate is at (10, 0, 1) inside the barn, accessible through the jungle door at (9, 0, 0). Player has a stone_axe in starting inventory for efficient mining. Spruce_fence_gate is not in starting inventory so its presence confirms successful mining.

Uses count_in_box_at_most because digging a hole means removing the dirt block. The single target dirt block is at spawn-relative (2, -1, -5) directly beneath the lime carpet marker at (2, 0, -5). Box is exactly one block [2,-1,-5] to [2,-1,-5] to check only this specific dirt block. Player retrieves stone shovel from chest, breaks the lime carpet, and digs the dirt. When dirt is removed, count drops to 0 satisfying max_count=0.

scene_description: A compact village area with three distinct zones: (1) A spawn area facing north, with a birch wall sign ~6 blocks to the south on an oak post providing directional hints (facing north so text is readable from spawn direction), (2) A farm/barn area to the east (~9-12 blocks) with a pig penned by oak fences at z=0 and barn walls at z=-3, a jungle door entrance, and a spruce fence gate inside, (3) A crafting hub to the north (~8-10 blocks) marked by a lodestone with a crafting table, and an adjacent storage room containing a potted brown mushroom and a chest with all crafting materials plus a stone shovel. A dirt patch with a lime carpet at (~2, 0, -5) marks the digging spot.
task_text: Explore this village: first find the birch sign to the south for directions. Follow its hints east to the farm to find the pig and jungle door, then north to the crafting hub with the lodestone. In the adjacent storage room (marked by a potted brown mushroom), gather materials from the chest. Craft a furnace (8 cobblestone in a ring), then dye white wool with magenta dye to make magenta wool and craft 2 magenta wool into magenta carpet. Craft a white bed (3 wool over 3 planks). Mine the spruce fence gate in the barn with your axe. Finally, use the shovel from the chest to dig a hole at the lime carpet marker.
commands: /setblock ~3 ~2 ~4 minecraft:birch_wall_sign[facing=north]{Text1:'{"text":"Farm: East ->"}',Text2:'{"text":"Crafting Hub: North"}',Text3:'{"text":"Dye wool for carpet!"}',Text4:'{"text":""}'}
design_notes: FINAL VERSION — All issues resolved: (1) Birch wall sign at (~3,2,4) uses facing=north so text is readable by player approaching from spawn (z=0 walking to z=4). (2) Dig spot marker changed from magenta_carpet to lime_carpet to prevent false-positive on 'craft to magenta_carpet' milestone. (3) Pig pen uses barn south wall (z=-3) as southern boundary and oak fences at z=0 as northern boundary — no z=-2 fence, giving pig a 2-block deep pen (z=-2 to z=-1). (4) All comment lines removed — 36 clean commands. (5) Cobblestone paths guide navigation: south to sign, east to barn, north to crafting hub. (6) Sign includes crafting hint 'Dye wool for carpet!' (7) Chest contains all needed materials with proper NBT byte formatting. (8) Player given stone_axe for mining fence gate. Layout: spawn at origin facing north, sign 6 blocks south, barn 9-12 blocks east, crafting hub 7-10 blocks north, storage room adjacent to hub, dig spot at (2,0,-5) between spawn and hub.
